title: Grade 5 Math — Fri, Jun 13
description: Simple Interest — Day 5 of 5: Mixed SI synthesis and challenge
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Deepak borrows ₹6000 at 7% per year for 3 years. What is the total amount he repays?
In 5 years at 8% per year, the SI on ₹P is ₹2000. What is P?
Simple interest at 10% for 1 year on ₹1000 is ___. For 2 years it is ___.
questions.explanation: Year 1: SI = ₹100. Year 2: another ₹100. Total for 2 years = ₹200. Same interest each year.

questions.question: P = ₹4000, R = 6%, Amount = ₹4720. For how many years was the money kept?
Reena deposited ₹12000. After 5 years at a certain rate she received ₹15000. What was the rate?
Which is the correct expanded formula for Amount (A)?
Two people invest the same amount for the same time. Person A gets 8% interest; person B gets 12%. Whose SI is higher?
questions.explanation: Higher rate = higher SI (P and T are the same). Person B at 12% earns more.

questions.question: Suresh deposits ₹10000 and wants to earn ₹3000 in 3 years. What rate does he need?
How long for ₹500 to earn ₹100 at 4% per year?
Aryan borrowed money and repaid ₹6600 after 1 year at 10% per year. What did he borrow?
P = ₹3000, R = 5%, T = 4 years. SI = ___. Amount = ___.
Nalini lent equal amounts to two friends. She charged 6% to one and 8% to the other, both for 2 years. Who paid more interest?
questions.explanation: Higher rate = more SI (P and T are the same). The 8% friend pays more.

questions.question: P = ₹5000, R = 6%, T = 3 years. After 3 years, how much MORE than the original amount does Priya get back?
questions.explanation: SI = (5000 × 6 × 3) ÷ 100 = ₹900. She gets back ₹900 MORE than her original ₹5000.
